purpose: Authoritative SAP Fieldglass protocol/evidence upgrade. Spec-level only: no sandbox or tenant credentials were used and writes remain disabled.

patch.evidenceNote: SAP's 2026 Fieldglass REST API General Reference Guide documents authenticated GET/POST/PUT integration resources over HTTPS with OAuth 2.0, client credentials, certificate and SAML-based authentication options. It explicitly references Connector, Identity (SCIM) and Reporting APIs, with an optional x-ApplicationKey depending on tenant/API. SAP's connector library also documents active-worker downloads and customer-specific contingent-workforce configurations such as custom fields, qualifications, rates and accounting mappings. No SAP Fieldglass sandbox or tenant authentication was attempted.

requiredPermissions: OAuth 2.0 client scoped to required Fieldglass REST/connector/reporting reads
optional tenant/application key only where the selected API requires it
worker/download permissions limited to required contingent-workforce data
PII, rates and accounting data minimised to the implemented WFM workflow
no upload, approval or worker mutation permission during discovery
dataAvailableOrExpected: active and contingent worker records exposed by authorised downloads/APIs
custom fields and qualifications where configured
rates and cost/accounting references where authorised
identity records through Fieldglass identity/SCIM integration where enabled
automationOpportunities: approved worker/time/cost lifecycle write-back only after separate sandbox and write-roundtrip certification
integration exception monitoring through audit/reporting data
customerValue: better agency and worker cost attribution
improved visibility of contingent workforce alongside employed labour
savingsHypotheses: reduce manual contingent-worker setup and reconciliation
reduce avoidable agency spend by exposing worker/rate/qualification context to planning
reduce compliance risk from incomplete qualification or worker-status data
reduce payroll/invoice exceptions caused by inconsistent external-worker master data
dataGaps: enabled connector/API resources and fields vary by buyer configuration
custom fields, qualifications, security IDs, rates and accounting mappings are customer-specific
some Fieldglass integrations remain file/connector based rather than a single normalized REST object model
constraintsRisks: REST resources support POST/PUT as well as GET, so read-only access must be enforced by permission and connector design
worker/rate/accounting data is sensitive and requires narrow retention and logging
OAuth tokens can have varying API access and must not be treated as least privilege by default
tenant region/environment URLs and test-environment availability vary
duplicate worker records can arise from customer segmentation/configuration and require deterministic identity reconciliation
valueReview.nextDevelopmentAction: Build a Fieldglass thin adapter over the existing REST/SCIM/file profiles, starting with OAuth token acquisition and read-only connector/reporting discovery; add canonical external-worker, qualification and rate mappings plus duplicate/segmentation handling, then seek an authorised SAP Fieldglass test tenant for authenticated read-roundtrip proof.
